title: HTML features in the specs that ship in browsers but are missing from VS Code

globalAttributes.name: headingoffset
globalAttributes.description: Offsets heading levels for descendants. Value: valid non-negative integer between 0 and 8. The `headingoffset` content attribute allows authors to offset heading levels for descendants.

globalAttributes.name: headingreset
globalAttributes.description: Prevents a heading offset computation from traversing beyond the element with the attribute. It allows authors to prevent a heading offset computation from traversing beyond the element with the attribute.
